title: centaurea langei subsp. rothmaleriana
intro: Centaurea langei subsp. rothmaleriana, commonly known as a type of Knapweed, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of respiratory issues. Centaurea langei subsp. rothmaleriana is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
